items.title_en: Has GPT-6-Astra Achieved Embodied Intelligence?
items.title_zh: GPT-6-Astra 实现具身智能了吗？
items.abstract_en: GPT-6-Astra demonstrates a level of competence in robotic manipulation and navigation that challenges the conventional paradigm of building specialized models for individual tasks and embodiments. In this report, we ask not only how capable GPT-6-Astra is, but what its capabilities imply for the field. First, we probe the limits of standalone GPT-6-Astra. We conduct a large-scale evaluation across 12 representative benchmarks spanning tabletop manipulation, humanoids, mobile platforms, and dexterous hands. Under a unified protocol that allows in-context learning (ICL) from training-set demonstrations and substantially increases the number of execution steps, GPT-6-Astra achieves unprecedented performance (Fig. 1). Future research may focus on improving 1) the generality of ICL 2) cost and execution time, 3) physical-state verification, 4) recovery from irreversible failures, and 5) long-horizon preservation of progress. Second, we study the agentic harness for embodied control. We identify that close-loop coordination between a high-level "System 2" reasoner (i.e., GPT-6-Astra) and a low-level "System 1" controller (e.g., π0.5) is costly but effective. Third, we examine GPT-6-Astra on real-world deployment. Our experiments on 8 robot configurations reveal substantial gaps: 1) robot demonstrations required for ICL are expensive to collect, and 2) it is implausible to trade longer execution for higher success rates with physical constraints. Fourth, we envision the next generation of embodied benchmarks. We develop a prototype that 1) derives tasks from real-world needs, 2) provides no in-domain demonstrations, and 3) judges agents on a world clock that keeps running while they deliberate. Taken together, our results suggest that GPT-6-Astra has largely crossed the threshold of embodied competence, but not yet that of practical embodied intelligence.
items.abstract_zh: GPT-6-Astra 在机器人操作与导航上的表现，挑战了为单一任务与本体定制专用模型的传统范式。我们在覆盖桌面操作、人形机器人、移动平台与灵巧手的 12 个代表性基准上开展大规模评测：在允许从训练集示范中进行上下文学习（ICL）并大幅增加执行步数的统一协议下，它取得了前所未有的性能；后续改进方向包括 ICL 的泛化性、成本与执行时间、物理状态校验、不可逆失败的恢复以及长时程进度保持。研究还发现，高层“System 2”推理器与低层“System 1”控制器（如 π0.5）的闭环协同代价高昂但有效；在 8 种真实机器人配置上的部署实验显示，ICL 所需示范采集昂贵，且受物理约束难以用更长执行时间换取更高成功率。最后我们提出下一代具身基准原型：任务源自真实需求、不提供域内示范，并按持续运转的世界时钟评判智能体。
items.highlight_zh: 12 个具身基准上性能空前，但真实部署仍有明显差距
items.digest_zh:
研究问题：像 GPT-6-Astra 这样的大型多模态模型，是否已经具备真正的具身智能（能在真实机器人上操作与导航），还是依旧需要为每个任务训练专用小模型？
方法：作者在 12 个代表性基准上做大规模评测，覆盖桌面操作、人形机器人、移动平台与灵巧手；采用统一协议，允许模型从训练集示范中做上下文学习（ICL），并大幅放宽执行步数上限。此外还测试了“System 2 推理器 + System 1 控制器”（如 π0.5）的闭环协同方案，并在 8 种真实机器人配置上做部署实验。
结果：在宽松协议下，GPT-6-Astra 取得前所未有的成绩；但真实部署暴露出明显差距——ICL 依赖的机器人示范数据采集成本很高，而物理世界有时间约束，无法靠“多想一会儿、多走几步”来换取成功率。闭环协同代价高但确实有效。
展望：作者列出五个待改进点：ICL 的泛化性、成本与执行时间、物理状态校验、不可逆失败的恢复、长时程任务的进度保持；并提出新一代基准原型：任务来自真实需求、不给域内示范、用持续走动的“世界时钟”计时。
为何重要：它给出一个清醒判断——大模型在具身任务上确有跃升，但评测环境的“宽松”与真实世界的“苛刻”之间仍隔着鸿沟，同时为社区指明了评测与改进的方向。

rm.usage: 面向通用具身智能体的大规模基准评测，结论（如高层推理+低层控制闭环、长时程进度保持）只能作为哨兵/工程机器人端到端策略设计的思路参考，不涉及 RM 具体环节，实操性弱。

items.title_en: OmniPoser: Flexible Human Motion Recovery in the Wild with Masked Flow Matching
items.title_zh: OmniPoser：基于掩码流匹配的野外灵活人体运动恢复
items.abstract_en: Recovering 3D human motion from sparse wearable sensors is challenging due to the inherent noise, occlusion, and instability of real-world tracking signals. Existing approaches are restricted to fixed sensor configurations and, when built on diffusion models, are computationally prohibitive for real-time deployment. We propose OmniPoser, a universal framework that recovers full-body SMPL motion from a flexible combination of heterogeneous inputs, such as 3D keypoints, sparse IMU rotations, head-mounted 6-DoF poses, or any subset thereof, within a single model. OmniPoser introduces a cross-modal masking mechanism paired with a Masked Conditioning Encoder, enabling one architecture to incorporate diverse sensor configurations through a masked design. A decoupled dual-stream generative backbone generates complete motion via Conditional Flow Matching, requiring only a single ODE integration step at inference. Across three settings and seven benchmarks, including in-the-wild Nymeria and Ego-Exo4D datasets, OmniPoser performs on par with state-of-the-art methods while running at over 700 FPS. The project page is available at https://jamesbridgewater51.github.io/omniposer-eccv/.
items.abstract_zh: 从稀疏可穿戴传感器恢复 3D 人体运动充满挑战，原因在于真实追踪信号的固有噪声、遮挡与不稳定。现有方法局限于固定的传感器配置，且基于扩散模型的方案计算开销大，难以实时部署。我们提出 OmniPoser，一个通用框架，可在单一模型中从异构输入的灵活组合恢复全身 SMPL 运动，输入可为 3D 关键点、稀疏 IMU 旋转、头戴式 6-DoF 位姿或其任意子集。OmniPoser 引入跨模态掩码机制与掩码条件编码器，使同一架构通过掩码设计兼容多种传感器配置；解耦的双流生成主干通过条件流匹配（Conditional Flow Matching）生成完整运动，推理时只需单步 ODE 积分。在三种设置、七个基准（包括野外场景的 Nymeria 与 Ego-Exo4D）上，OmniPoser 性能与当前最先进方法相当，运行速度超过 700 FPS。
items.highlight_zh: 一个模型适配任意传感器组合，单步生成、700+ FPS 实时
items.digest_zh:
研究问题：只用少量可穿戴传感器（IMU、头显、少量关键点）实时还原全身 3D 动作，是 VR/AR、数字人和机器人遥操作的关键。难点在于信号有噪声、易遮挡、会漂移；已有方法要么只支持固定的传感器组合，要么依赖扩散模型、太慢而无法实时。
方法：OmniPoser 走“一个模型通吃”的路线。它把不同模态输入（3D 关键点、稀疏 IMU 旋转、头戴 6-DoF 位姿等）统一到掩码框架中：训练时随机遮盖部分模态，配合掩码条件编码器，使模型学会在“缺哪补哪”的情况下工作，因此任意子集输入都能处理。生成部分采用解耦的双流主干与条件流匹配，推理只需一步 ODE 积分即可输出完整的 SMPL 动作序列。
结果：在三种设置、七个基准（含真实场景的 Nymeria、Ego-Exo4D）上，精度与当前最优方法相当，速度超过 700 FPS，满足实时要求。
为何重要：它把“传感器配置”从硬性约束变成可调选项——同一套模型可适配不同硬件；同时用流匹配把扩散类方法的采样成本压到单步，让高保真动作恢复真正具备落地可能。
items.comment: Accepted as a poster at the European Conference on Computer Vision (ECCV) 2026

rm.usage: 从稀疏 IMU/关键点恢复人体运动，与 RM 的装甲识别、导航、决策等任务无关，几乎用不上。

items.title_en: I2V-DETACH: Source Grounding Detachment for Unauthorized Image-to-Video Generation
items.title_zh: I2V-DETACH：面向未授权图像到视频生成的源接地分离
items.abstract_en: Recent diffusion models have advanced image-conditioned video generation, but their accessibility raises risks of unauthorized manipulation. Image immunization has emerged as a promising defense for Image-to-Video (I2V) protection, yet existing methods often rely on degrading visual quality or temporal coherence. In this work, we revisit I2V immunization as reducing source-content preservation, shifting the focus from output degradation to weakening source-conditioned content propagation. To this end, we propose I2V-DETACH, an image immunization method that prevents unauthorized I2V generation through source grounding detachment. I2V models preserve source content by propagating source-image cues into video latents during denoising. Accordingly, I2V-DETACH disrupts this process in two complementary ways: it suppresses source-video grounding to reduce source cue propagation, and strengthens intra-video interactions to shift denoising toward video-side dynamics with reduced reliance on the source image. To obtain informative optimization signals, we initialize auxiliary video latents with source-oriented states that remain within the source-conditioned generation regime while deviating from source-preserving trajectories. Extensive experiments across diverse diffusion architectures show that I2V-DETACH substantially reduces source-content preservation, improves over prior immunization methods, and exhibits strong black-box transferability.
items.abstract_zh: 近期扩散模型推动了图像条件视频生成的发展，但其易得性也带来未授权操纵的风险。图像免疫已成为保护图像、抵御图像到视频（I2V）滥用的一种有前景的防御手段，然而现有方法往往依赖降低视觉质量或时间连贯性。本文将 I2V 免疫重新表述为降低源内容保持度，把焦点从输出退化转向削弱以源图像为条件的内容传播。为此我们提出 I2V-DETACH，一种通过源接地分离阻止未授权 I2V 生成的图像免疫方法。I2V 模型在去噪过程中将源图像线索传播到视频潜变量以保持源内容，I2V-DETACH 从两方面打断这一过程：抑制源—视频接地以减少源线索传播；增强视频内部交互，使去噪转向视频一侧的动态并降低对源图像的依赖。为获得有信息量的优化信号，我们用面向源的状态初始化辅助视频潜变量，使其处于源条件生成区间内又偏离保持源的轨迹。在多种扩散架构上的实验表明，I2V-DETACH 显著降低源内容保持度，优于既有免疫方法，并具有强黑盒迁移性。
items.highlight_zh: 不做降质，靠切断源图线索传播阻断未授权 I2V 生成
items.digest_zh:
研究问题：图像到视频（I2V）模型可被用来把他人照片改成未授权视频。现有防御（图像免疫）多靠往图里加扰动，让输出变糊、变抖，但这会明显损害画质，也容易被绕过。
方法：作者换了个视角——防御目标不该是“让生成变差”，而应是“让生成不再忠实于原图”。I2V 模型之所以能保留原图内容，是因为去噪时不断把源图线索注入视频潜变量。I2V-DETACH 双管齐下打断这条通路：一是抑制源图与视频之间的“接地”关联，减少线索传播；二是加强视频帧内部的相互作用，让去噪更多依据视频自身动态。为了获得有效的优化信号，还用“贴近源图状态但偏离保持轨迹”的状态初始化辅助潜变量，使扰动更有针对性。
结果：在多种扩散架构上，源内容保持度显著下降，效果优于已有免疫方法，并且在黑盒（不了解对方模型）条件下也能迁移生效。
为何重要：它把 I2V 防护从“降质式”防御变成“内容脱钩式”防御，更隐蔽，也更难被简单去噪或滤波破解，对创作者肖像与作品保护具有现实意义。

rm.usage: 图像免疫与 I2V 生成防护研究，属于生成内容版权保护方向，与 RM 赛场上任何算法环节均无关联。

items.title_en: Diversity Without Labels: Task-Agnostic Coreset Selection Across Perception and Action
items.title_zh: 无标签的多样性：跨感知与动作的任务无关核心集选择
items.abstract_en: While data collection for model training is relatively easy, curating high-quality datasets from large collections is inherently challenging. Coreset estimation methods address this problem by identifying the best data subsets to train models on. However, existing approaches often require proxy model training, extensive annotations, or task-specific tailoring. Unsupervised alternatives typically exploit geometric properties in foundation model feature spaces, but are limited to pairwise image-to-image comparisons or comparisons against a fixed subset. We introduce CoreDNA, an unsupervised, task-agnostic coreset estimation approach that pools neuron activations from vision foundation models into per-image and per-dataset distributions. By comparing each image's distribution to the dataset-level distribution, CoreDNA can capture both low-level visual structure and high-level semantic information across layers. We find that high-quality samples concentrate in the tails of the last layer's activation statistics, which we validate by relating them to training-based coreset methods. Building on these findings, we develop a computationally efficient selection mechanism to construct task-agnostic, high-quality coresets for selective annotation and model training. Across image classification, semantic segmentation, depth estimation, and imitation learning for end-to-end driving and mobile manipulation, CoreDNA matches or outperforms the state of the art, demonstrating unprecedented generalization across perception and action tasks. These results highlight the effectiveness of compact activation-based representations for data selection.
items.abstract_zh: 模型训练所需的数据采集相对容易，但从大规模数据集合中筛选出高质量数据集本身却很难。核心集（coreset）估计方法通过找出最适合训练的数据子集来解决这一问题，但现有方法往往需要代理模型训练、大量标注或任务特定的定制。无监督替代方案通常利用基础模型特征空间中的几何性质，却局限于成对的图像间比较或与固定子集的比较。我们提出 CoreDNA，一种无监督、任务无关的核心集估计方法：它将视觉基础模型中的神经元激活汇聚为每张图像以及整个数据集的分布，通过比较图像分布与数据集级分布，跨层同时捕捉低层视觉结构与高层语义信息。我们发现高质量样本集中于最后一层激活统计的尾部，并通过与基于训练的核心集方法建立关联加以验证。基于这些发现，我们设计了计算高效的选择机制，为选择性标注与模型训练构建任务无关的高质量核心集。在图像分类、语义分割、深度估计，以及端到端驾驶与移动操作的模仿学习上，CoreDNA 达到或超过最先进水平，展现出跨感知与动作任务的空前泛化能力。
items.highlight_zh: 用基础模型激活分布挑数据，无监督且跨感知与动作通用
items.digest_zh:
研究问题：训练数据容易攒，难的是从海量数据里挑出“最有价值的一小部分”（核心集，coreset）。已有方法要么得先训练代理模型，要么依赖大量标注，要么只针对某个任务定制；无监督方法又通常只做成对图像比较，视野有限。
方法：CoreDNA 的思路是看“神经元怎么被激活”。它把视觉基础模型各层的激活汇聚成两个分布——单张图像的分布和整个数据集的分布，再比较二者差异，这样既能反映低层纹理结构，也能反映高层语义。作者发现一个有意思的规律：高质量样本往往落在最后一层激活统计的尾部（离群一侧），并用与基于训练的核心集方法的相关性验证了这一点。基于此，他们设计了计算高效的选择机制。
结果：在图像分类、语义分割、深度估计，以及端到端驾驶与移动操作的模仿学习上，CoreDNA 达到或超过现有最优方法，且完全无监督、任务无关——同一个方法能同时服务“感知”和“动作”类任务。
为何重要：这说明基础模型的激活统计本身就是一种廉价而通用的数据质量信号，可以在不训练、不标注的情况下筛选数据，对降低数据筛选成本、提升下游训练效率有直接价值。

rm.usage: 无监督核心集选择可用于筛选装甲板/能量机关等视觉训练集，在标注预算有限时挑出高质量样本加速检测模型迭代；但它只是数据侧工具，不解决自瞄算法本身。
rm.task: 装甲板自瞄与射击控制

items.title_en: ReVision: Reprogramming Image Generators for Dense Visual Perception
items.title_zh: ReVision：重编程图像生成器用于稠密视觉感知
items.abstract_en: Recent image generators exhibit rich visual priors that can support dense visual perception. However, existing approaches typically encode multiple perception tasks into a shared parameterization, making joint training sensitive to the mixture and weighting of heterogeneous data and prone to cross-task interference. To address this issue, we introduce ReVision, an instruction-conditioned parameter generation framework built on a frozen multimodal understanding model and a frozen image generator. Given an image and a free-form instruction, the understanding model jointly encodes them into a multimodal image--instruction representation, which a trainable parameter generator maps to transient low-rank updates for the generator. Each image--instruction pair induces a distinct set of transient prediction parameters, enabling instance-specific adaptation while both pretrained backbones remain unchanged. ReVision requires no task-specific heads, explicit task identifiers, or stored adapters. A shared RGB output interface unifies segmentation, depth estimation, and surface-normal prediction. Across diverse dense prediction benchmarks, ReVision achieves competitive performance with state-of-the-art methods while supporting flexible task specification through natural-language instructions. Our analysis further reveals substantial gradient disagreement across tasks, highlighting the conflict introduced when heterogeneous objectives share a single parameterization. Meanwhile, the generated updates exhibit structured task- and input-dependent organization in weight space, further validating instance-level parameter generation for multi-task perception.
items.abstract_zh: 近期图像生成器蕴含丰富的视觉先验，可支撑稠密视觉感知。但现有方法把多个感知任务编码进共享参数化，联合训练对异构数据的混合与权重敏感，且易产生跨任务干扰。我们提出 ReVision——一个基于冻结多模态理解模型与冻结图像生成器的指令条件参数生成框架：给定图像与自由形式指令，理解模型将其联合编码为多模态图像—指令表示，可训练的参数生成器再把它映射为生成器权重上的瞬态低秩更新，使每对图像—指令诱导出各自独立的预测参数，实现实例级自适应而两个预训练骨干保持不变。该方法无需任务专用头、显式任务标识或存储适配器，统一 RGB 输出接口涵盖分割、深度估计与表面法向量预测。多项基准上性能与最先进方法相当，并支持用自然语言指令灵活指定任务；分析显示任务间存在显著梯度冲突，而生成的更新在权重空间中呈结构化的任务与输入依赖组织。
items.highlight_zh: 指令生成瞬态低秩参数，冻结骨干统一稠密预测
items.digest_zh:
要解决的问题：图像生成模型（如扩散模型）在训练中已学到大量关于物体形状、深度与光照的“视觉常识”，但想把它直接用于分割、深度估计等稠密感知任务并不容易。以往做法是把多个任务塞进同一套共享参数里联合训练，结果对数据配比和损失权重极其敏感，任务之间还会互相干扰（一种任务变好，另一种可能变差）。

方法思路：作者提出 ReVision，让冻结（不更新）的多模态理解模型读入“图像 + 一句自然语言指令”（例如“找出所有行人”），把它编码成一个融合表示；再用一个小的可训练网络把这个表示转换成一小组低秩的临时权重补丁，注入到同样冻结的图像生成器中。也就是说，每张图配一句指令，就现场“重编程”出一套专属参数，用完即弃，不做永久存储。输出统一为 RGB 图像形式，因此分割掩码、深度图、表面法向量都能用同一接口表达。

主要结果：在多个稠密预测基准上，ReVision 与当前最先进方法表现相当，同时用户可用自然语言自由指定任务，而无需切换模型头。作者还做了梯度分析，显示不同任务在同一套参数上确实互相拉扯，印证了共享参数的弊端；而生成的临时权重补丁在参数空间中呈现出有规律的组织，说明它确实在按任务和输入“定制”参数。

为何重要：它提供了一条不必为每个任务单独训练或保存适配器的多任务感知路线，把“任务切换”简化为“换一句话说”，对通用视觉基础模型的实用化很有启发。

rm.usage: 用冻结的理解模型+生成器做指令条件下的深度/分割/法向量稠密预测，可尝试为哨兵提供单目稠密深度以补充避障与地形判断，但需评估实时性与精度。
rm.task: 哨兵机器人自主导航与决策

items.title_en: Reliability-Consistent Appearance Modeling for RGB-Infrared Multi-Object Tracking
items.title_zh: 面向 RGB-红外多目标跟踪的可靠性一致外观建模
items.abstract_en: Recent RGB-infrared multi-object tracking (MOT) methods have substantially improved cross-modal representation learning and multimodal information integration. However, most existing methods compress RGB and infrared evidence into a unified descriptor. When one modality is temporarily degraded, the tracker can no longer regulate its contribution separately; unreliable evidence may distort association and contaminate appearance memory. We therefore propose RCA-MOT, a reliability-consistent appearance modeling framework that preserves cross-modal complementarity while retaining post-representation evidence controllability. RGB-specific, infrared-specific, and fused identity representations are maintained as jointly accessible appearance states. For each detection, a simple training-free target-scene estimator produces branch-wise appearance reliability used across the two temporal roles of appearance: relative reliability regulates different identity branches, absolute reliability calibrates borderline candidates near the ReID acceptance boundary, and the same branch-wise reliability controls how strongly matched descriptors update historical appearance memory. The individual components are intentionally simple, focusing evaluation on reliability-controllable appearance organization rather than elaborate fusion or learned reliability-estimation modules. RCA-MOT sets new SOTA results on VT-MOT and UniRTL, improving the previous best HOTA by 5.402/6.075 points and IDF1 by 11.549/12.789 points, respectively, while post-hoc analyses further validate reliability as an informative control signal. Code will be released upon acceptance.
items.abstract_zh: 现有 RGB-红外多目标跟踪方法多把两种模态的证据压缩成一个统一描述子，一旦某一模态暂时退化，跟踪器便无法单独调节其贡献，不可靠证据会扭曲关联并污染外观记忆。为此提出 RCA-MOT，一个可靠性一致的外观建模框架，在保留跨模态互补性的同时维持表示之后的证据可控性：RGB 专属、红外专属与融合身份表示被并列维护为可联合访问的外观状态。对每个检测，一个简单的免训练目标场景估计器给出分支级外观可靠性，并将其用于外观的两种时序角色——相对可靠性调节不同身份分支，绝对可靠性校准 ReID 接受边界附近的边缘候选，同一分支可靠性还控制匹配描述子更新历史外观记忆的强度。各组件刻意保持简单，以便把评测聚焦于可靠性可控的外观组织。RCA-MOT 在 VT-MOT 与 UniRTL 上刷新 SOTA，HOTA 分别提升 5.402/6.075 点，IDF1 提升 11.549/12.789 点。
items.highlight_zh: 免训练可靠性估计，分模态调控外观记忆
items.digest_zh:
要解决的问题：RGB-红外多目标跟踪要在白天可见光与夜间热成像之间取长补短。但大多数方法把两种模态的信息早早“揉”成一个外观特征向量，之后就无法再区分哪部分来自哪个模态。一旦某个模态临时失效（如红外过曝、可见光太暗或遮挡），错误的外观证据会混进匹配过程，把轨迹关联搞乱，还会污染长期保存的外观记忆。

方法思路：作者提出 RCA-MOT，核心是“别急着融合，先把各路证据分开存、按可靠性分别用”。系统同时维护三套外观表示：RGB 专属、红外专属和融合身份特征。对每个检测框，用一个简单的免训练估计器（不需要额外标注或训练）算出各分支的外观可靠度。这个可靠度被用在两个地方：一是相对可靠度决定匹配时更信任哪个身份分支；二是在 ReID 接受门限附近，用绝对可靠度对“临界候选”做校准，减少误接受；同时它还决定匹配上的描述子以多大强度去更新历史外观记忆，证据越不可靠，更新越轻。

主要结果：作者刻意把各模块做得简单，是为了证明“可靠度可控的外观组织”本身就是关键，而不是靠更花哨的融合网络。在 VT-MOT 与 UniRTL 两个基准上刷新最好成绩，HOTA 比之前最佳分别高出约 5.4 和 6.1 个百分点，IDF1 高出约 11.5 和 12.8 个百分点；事后分析也验证可靠度确实是有效的控制信号。

为何重要：它把多模态跟踪中“何时该信谁”的问题显式化、可调节化，方法轻量、易于移植到其他多模态感知任务。
items.comment: 10 pages, 6 figures. Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Multimedia

items.title_en: Frame-Consistent Feed-Forward 3D Gaussian Splatting from Sparse Unposed Images
items.title_zh: 基于稀疏无位姿图像的帧一致前馈3D Gaussian Splatting
items.abstract_en: Feed-forward Gaussian models have made novel view synthesis almost instantaneous. Feed-forward methods predict Gaussians directly, either in two stages or in a single merged pass. Using two separately trained models is attractive because each can specialize in its own objective: one for accurate pose estimation and the other for high-quality reconstruction, rather than forcing a single jointly trained network to compromise between the two. A natural instantiation pairs a frozen pose estimator, VGGT, with a frozen reconstruction backbone, TokenGS. Prior work, such as VGGT-X and 3R-GS, also adopts a two-stage design, but attributes the resulting quality degradation to noisy pose estimates and introduces learned refinement. We show that this is not the primary source of the problem. Through per-camera analysis across 107 scenes from two datasets, DL3DV and MipNeRF360, using COLMAP poses as the reference, we find that the rotation error after alignment is small (median 1.6 degrees), whereas the translation scale is offset by a large, dataset-consistent factor. Controlled ablations over 140 DL3DV scenes show that the primary obstacles are two integration failures rather than pose error: a coordinate-frame inconsistency and a translation-scale mismatch, both of which can be corrected deterministically. With these fixes, a frozen VGGT driving a frozen TokenGS achieves 22.47 PSNR, within 0.51 dB of the COLMAP reference, with no additional training, when poses are estimated from all scene views. In the sparse setting, where reconstruction uses only four context images under the standard pose-free protocol, the same pipeline matches this all-view quality, yielding a fully COLMAP-free pipeline without any refinement step.

items.title_en: MambaAct: Efficient Mamba Action Experts for Flow-Matching Vision-Language-Action Models
items.title_zh: MambaAct：面向流匹配视觉-语言-动作模型的高效Mamba动作专家
items.abstract_en: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have shown strong promise for generalist robotic manipulation, but their inference cost remains a major bottleneck for real-time control. This limitation is especially pronounced in flow-matching VLAs such as $π_{0.5}$, where the action expert is evaluated repeatedly during iterative denoising. We introduce MambaAct, an efficient Mamba action expert for flow-matching VLA policies. MambaAct retains the pretrained visual-language prefix encoder of $π_{0.5}$, while replacing its transformer-based action expert with a compact Mamba-based action expert. Within this expert, Mamba serves as the action mixer that models dependencies across the noisy continuous-action sequence. To preserve visual-language conditioning without repeated token-level cross-attention, MambaAct uses a lightweight Context Compressor to map Vision-language model (VLM) prefix tokens into a compact conditioning signal that gates and modulates each Mamba action block. MambaAct uses a $10\times$ smaller action expert and reduces flow-matching denoising latency by $64.8\%$ on LIBERO and $58.8\%$ in real-world deployment, while improving mean LIBERO success by $1.08$ percentage points across three independent fine-tuning seeds and maintaining gains on LIBERO-Plus and real-world benchmarks. Our code and model weights are publicly available at https://github.com/giakhuyendihoc/MambaAct.

items.title_en: UniW(A)M: A Unified Mixture-of-Experts Framework for World and World-Action Models
items.title_zh: UniW(A)M：面向世界模型与世界-动作模型的统一混合专家框架
items.abstract_en: World models (WMs) and world-action models (WAMs) focus on future world prediction and executable action generation, respectively. Although these models learn shared physical dynamics and interaction semantics from embodied trajectories, they are typically trained in isolation, which restricts knowledge reuse between prediction and control. The central challenge is therefore to develop a unified learning framework that shares these dynamics while preserving the distinct modeling capabilities required by each paradigm. We propose UniW(A)M, a mixture-of-experts world-(action) model built upon diffusion Transformers that unifies action-conditioned world modeling and diverse WAM variants. Shared experts capture common dynamics, while atomic capability experts are reused across interfaces so that each interface keeps its own conditional pathway. At deployment, a plug-in adaptive interface router (PAIR) learns from a small subset of target-task chunk scenarios to select a suitable WAM interface for each execution chunk, balancing task success and execution efficiency while keeping the backbone frozen. We evaluate UniW(A)M on LIBERO, RoboTwin 2.0, and three real-world manipulation tasks, where it achieves 88.3% average real-world success versus 76.7% for the strongest baseline. On WorldArena, it leads action-conditioned world modeling on all three tasks. AC-WM co-training contributes to action generation on every action interface and PAIR raises OOD success from 63.3% to 76.7%.

items.title_en: Urbex: Agentic Spatial Grounding for City-Scale 3D Scenes
items.title_zh: Urbex：面向城市级3D场景的智能体式空间定位
items.abstract_en: City-scale 3D grounding is commonly formulated as candidate ranking, which requires precomputed instance proposals and becomes inefficient in large outdoor scenes. We propose Urbex, an agentic vision-language framework that instead casts grounding as active spatial search. Urbex represents a city-scale 3D scene as an interactive multi-view environment, allowing a VLM agent to query landmarks, zoom into local regions, render oblique views, and commit a grounded bounding box. We optimize this tool-use policy with reinforcement learning on CityRefer, using smooth localization rewards and lightweight shaping rewards for efficient exploration. Experiments show that Urbex achieves the best Hit@1 and IoU on CityRefer, supports candidate-free grounding without ground-truth boxes, and is substantially faster than the strongest city-scale ranking baseline. Zero-shot results on STPLS3D-Refer further indicate improved cross-scene robustness.

items.title_en: STRIDE: Evaluating Spatiotemporal Reasoning in Driving Edge Cases
items.title_zh: STRIDE：评估驾驶边缘场景中的时空推理
items.abstract_en: In autonomous driving, perceiving surrounding objects is not enough: failing to understand how they move and interact over time can lead to dangerous decisions. Evaluating vision-language models (VLMs) therefore requires testing whether they connect past spatial observations to future consequences. Yet existing benchmarks often assess edge cases through basic perception questions or test temporal understanding in simple scenarios, leaving complex spatiotemporal reasoning underexplored. We introduce STRIDE (SpatioTemporal Reasoning In Driving Edge Cases), an object-centric benchmark for long-tail, safety-critical driving scenarios. STRIDE covers six task families: spatial perception, spatial understanding, temporal memory, temporal extrapolation, trajectory prediction, and scene-context awareness. It pairs multiple-choice questions probing individual spatiotemporal judgments with related free-form visual question answering (VQA) requiring detailed scene explanations and justifications of driving decisions. We prioritize scenes with unusual object behaviors and complex traffic interactions, generate reference answers from structured dataset annotations through automated procedures, and use limited language-model assistance and human verification to ensure annotation quality. Across 12 proprietary, open-weight, and driving-specialized models, even the best performer, GPT-6-Astra, achieves only 43.4% average multiple-choice accuracy, versus an approximately 20% random-choice baseline. Further analysis reveals that strong performance in describing driving scenes does not necessarily translate to accurate safety-critical judgments, and that models struggle more with reconstructing object motion than recalling past positions. STRIDE thus exposes spatiotemporal driving limitations that aggregate VQA scores can conceal.

rm.usage: 评估VLM时空推理的驾驶边缘场景基准，与RoboMaster自瞄、导航、决策的实时算法无直接关系，最多作为战术推理评测思路参考。

items.title_en: Micro-Localization: High-Precision Mobile Robot Localization Using Microscopic Ground Texture
items.title_zh: Micro-Localization：利用微观地面纹理的高精度移动机器人定位
items.abstract_en: We demonstrate high-precision global localization using natural ground texture viewed through microscope optics, achieving localization in the tens-of-micrometers regime. For the planar ground texture localization problem considered here, we relate optical magnification and image-space localization uncertainty to physical localization precision. Leveraging this relationship, we then develop a microscope-based localization system that addresses the calibration, camera-modeling, and focus challenges introduced by high-magnification imaging. We evaluate this system across several surface textures using a calibrated precision gantry. Across 1,007 held-out queries per surface, the system localizes every query and achieves translation RMSEs of 28$-$73 $μ$m. Independent photometric registration agrees with the feature-based localization estimates to within approximately 9 $μ$m RMSE. We further demonstrate localization on a low-cost mobile robot using the gantry-collected maps, and also show that the system can resolve micrometer-scale displacement caused by thermal expansion. These results show that microscopic natural surface texture can bring mobile localization into a precision regime typically associated with fixed positioning systems.

items.title_en: Learning the Shared Latent Structure of Cryo-EM Inverse Problems
items.title_zh: 学习冷冻电镜反问题的共享潜结构
items.abstract_en: Understanding biomolecular function requires characterizing three-dimensional structure and conformational variability, for which cryogenic electron microscopy (cryo-EM) is a powerful tool. Cryo-EM produces noisy two-dimensional particle images in which molecular structure, particle pose, and imaging conditions are jointly encoded. Recovering biological information from these observations spans inverse problems including pose estimation, heterogeneity analysis, and reconstruction. These tasks are usually addressed independently despite shared protein structure and image formation, motivating a common representation across inverse problems. Since biologically meaningful differences may be spatially localized, we study self-distillation with complementary global and masked patch objectives. Because experimental dataset discrimination can reflect acquisition-specific cues, we develop controlled synthetic and experimental evaluations and find that structural discrimination benefits from dense spatial features. We introduce the EMber family of vision transformers, pre-trained on >50 million experimental particle images from 214 EMPIAR datasets together with simulated projections from 268,000 molecular assemblies. EMber improves upon existing methods at conformational and compositional discrimination by 14.85 and 14.26 percentage points, estimates conformational populations to within 1.59pp error with a linear probe, and produces particle assignments yielding reference-quality reconstructions in fewer epochs. We demonstrate how to learn representations that capture biological information for use across multiple cryo-EM inverse problems.

items.title_en: TriSAR-3D and PaintFusion: A Novel Trimodal LiDAR-RGB-Thermal Dataset and Method for 3D Person Detection in Search and Rescue
items.title_zh: TriSAR-3D与PaintFusion：面向搜救中3D人员检测的新型三模态LiDAR-RGB-热成像数据集与方法
items.abstract_en: Reliable 3D person detection is important for rescue robotics to give first responders situational awareness. Yet most multimodal 3D detection research targets automotive scenarios in which pedestrians mostly appear in a narrow range of upright, near-road poses. It is therefore unclear how much of the reported performance transfers to rescue settings, as a person may be lying, partially occluded, or in unstructured indoor and outdoor environments. To investigate this gap, we introduce TriSAR-3D, a multimodal person detection dataset recorded with a high-resolution 128-channel LiDAR, an RGB camera, and a thermal camera. It captures varied poses in indoor as well as outdoor locations at different times of day to study their influence on 3D object detector performance. Furthermore, we propose a novel trimodal 3D detection pipeline, PaintFusion, that fuses PointPainting-based evidence using a simple MLP. We show that the derived method reaches 65.4 AP@50 and thereby outperforms strong LiDAR-only (CenterPoint, 53.4), RGB+LiDAR (BEVFusion, 60.5), and adapted trimodal (Tri-BEVFusion, 60.7) baselines on the dataset. At the same time, it is substantially faster than other fusion-based methods such as BEVFusion, with a per-frame latency of 51.6 ms compared to 101 ms. Additionally, we test how the performance of different 3D object detectors generalizes to unseen pose categories. Removing lying instances from training data collapses the lying-pose AP@50 to near zero across all evaluated detectors. The results indicate that dataset diversity exerts a large effect on 3D object detection performance. The dataset and code are available at https://github.com/MarkusKramer1/3D-Trimodal-People-Detection.

items.title_en: KFS$^4$LAM: Adaptive KeyFrame Selection with Structure-Aware Mapping for Endoscopic Gaussian Splatting SLAM
items.title_zh: KFS$^4$LAM：面向内窥镜Gaussian Splatting SLAM的自适应关键帧选择与结构感知建图
items.abstract_en: Gaussian-splatting Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (SLAM) augments conventional SLAM with a dense, renderable 3D scene representation, enabling high-quality reconstruction and novel-view synthesis. However, its localization, reconstruction, and rendering performance depends strongly on which observations are retained for mapping. Existing systems commonly rely on fixed temporal intervals or simple pose- and overlap-based criteria for keyframe selection. In colonoscopy, non-uniform camera motion, repetitive anatomy, specularities, and visual artifacts can make these criteria unreliable, leading to either redundant keyframes or missed informative viewpoints. We present KFS$^4$LAM (KeyFrame Selection with Structure-aware mapping for endoscopic Gaussian Splatting SLAM), which couples motion-guided adaptive keyframe selection with structurally supervised mapping and restricted temporal deformation. Accumulated motion guides adaptive keyframe selection, with complementary cues suppressing redundant or unreliable candidates. Density-aware mapping with anatomical contour supervision (colon folds) emphasizes structurally informative regions, while restricted temporal deformation accommodates local tissue dynamics without unconstrained geometric drift. We evaluate KFS$^4$LAM against Gaussian-SLAM baselines on C3VD and C3VD-v2, together with cross-backbone and component ablations. KFS$^4$LAM achieves strong overall performance across trajectory, rendering, and depth metrics, with pronounced gains on more challenging C3VD-v2 dataset. In the matched comparison with SplaTAM on C3VD-v2, it reduces rotational relative pose error by 20.3% and depth RMSE by 38.4%, while improving PSNR by 0.78 dB. Cross-backbone experiments further show that the framework is not tied to a single underlying SLAM architecture. Code and visualization results are available at https://xinweiju.github.io/KFSLAM/.

items.title_en: Gen4P: Video Generators are 4D Perceivers
items.title_zh: Gen4P：视频生成器是4D感知器
items.abstract_en: We introduce Gen4P, a unified framework for recovering 4D geometry and motion from monocular video. We show that a pretrained video generator can be repurposed into a feed-forward 4D perceiver without iterative denoising. Building on on-demand querying, Gen4P processes clean video latents in a single encoder pass and predicts the requested 4D attributes through a lightweight cross-attention decoder. The on-demand query formulation enables flexible spatial sampling, and our proposed continuous-time queries further provide temporal flexibility. To strengthen geometric knowledge, we propose a straightforward plug-in solution by incorporating a pretrained video-depth LoRA as a frozen geometry prior, improving overall performance without adding extra trainable parameters. Gen4P achieves state-of-the-art or competitive performance on tasks of 3D point tracking, video depth and camera pose estimation. Qualitative results on in-the-wild videos illustrate its capability of tracking complex motion while maintaining the delicate structure. Together, these results demonstrate the potential of video generative pretraining for unified 4D perception. See https://gen4p.github.io for more visual results.

items.title_en: Perceive, Predict, and Plan: a Unified World Action Model for Egocentric Dexterous Manipulation
items.title_zh: 感知、预测与规划：面向第一人称视角灵巧操作的统一世界动作模型
items.abstract_en: We introduce P$^{3}$-WAM, a unified world action model for egocentric dexterous manipulation that learns 3D perception, action-conditioned prediction, and goal-directed planning through three complementary modes: Perceive, which reconstructs articulated hand motion and camera trajectories from video; Predict, which generates visual futures under prescribed actions; and Plan, which jointly generates action trajectories and their anticipated visual consequences conditioned on an initial image, a language instruction, and an optional visual goal. Our model integrates a compact, structured 3D action representation into a pretrained video diffusion transformer through a mixture-of-transformers architecture with shared base weights, modality-specific adaptation, and bidirectional visual-action attention. Randomized modality visibility lets video and 3D actions serve as either conditioning context or prediction targets across the three modes. Experiments show that unified training improves all three capabilities over single-mode training, including gains in planning quality under a vision-language model evaluation. Through unified training, our model outperforms specialized baselines on 3D hand reconstruction and action-conditioned video prediction across four datasets, while producing goal-directed manipulation videos with stronger instruction adherence and action progression than video-generation baselines. Project Page: https://p3-wam.pages.dev/

items.title_en: Routing Policy Optimization for Online Diffusion Reinforcement Learning
items.title_zh: 面向在线扩散强化学习的路由策略优化
items.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning can align visual generators with reward signals beyond their pretraining objectives, but existing score-function methods typically introduce stochasticity by perturbing the reverse denoising trajectory, leading to costly rollout-based optimization. We instead ask whether stochastic exploration can be introduced inside the generator while preserving its original sampler. Routing Policy Optimization (RPO) answers this question by turning attention routing into a stochastic exploration action. At a few selected denoising levels, each query block keeps its own block and samples further key blocks in proportion to the generator's native attention mass, or keeps dense attention. The sampled route perturbs the velocity of that transition, and a Gaussian likelihood around the dense velocity scores the perturbation with a score-function objective. RPO further uses a controlled two-rollout estimator: two rollouts share the same prompt, initial latent, routed denoising levels, and dense anchor layers, differing only in their sampled attention routes. Their reward difference provides an advantage signal for the routed transitions. Because the likelihood differentiates the dense velocity itself, the learned updates remain effective after routing is removed. At inference, RPO restores dense attention and retains the original deterministic sampler. Experiments on text-to-image and text-to-video generation show that RPO improves generation quality while achieving nearly 4x higher training efficiency than Flow-GRPO-style methods. Please see our project page at https://velox-world.com/rpo for visual results.

items.title_en: MMSearch-OPD: Easy Made Hard, Hard Made Learnable for Long-Horizon Multimodal Search Agents
items.title_zh: MMSearch-OPD：化易为难、化难为可学——面向长程多模态搜索智能体
items.abstract_en: Multimodal deep search is moving from short queries to long-horizon investigations that continually acquire evidence. However, training such agents remains constrained by limited challenging training questions and insufficient process feedback. We introduce MMSearch-OPD, combining controllable data refinement with joint reinforcement learning (RL) and on-policy distillation (OPD). Our Refine pipeline performs targeted expansion of reasoning chains derived from existing simple multimodal questions. Parameterized transformations control search depth and cross-modal evidence requirements while reusing existing image--question pairs. For training, answer rewards and lightweight behavior penalties guide RL, while the reward gap modulates token-level teacher guidance on imperfect student trajectories. An exponentially decaying distillation coefficient reduces teacher dependence as training proceeds. Experiments show gains from data refinement and further improvements from joint training after SFT, indicating stronger long-horizon multimodal deep search capabilities.

items.title_en: An Agentic ENF Framework for Forensic Video Authentication Against Generative AI
items.title_zh: 一种智能体化 ENF 框架：面向抵御生成式 AI 的取证视频认证
items.abstract_en: Generative models now synthesise video that is hard to distinguish from genuine footage, and learned detectors that key on a generator's artefacts degrade sharply on unseen models. This paper develops a forensic framework that authenticates video by a signal that generation does not control: the electric network frequency (ENF), the mains-driven hum in audio and flicker in video. A unified two-channel detector extracts the ENF from audio and from rolling-shutter video through one second harmonic estimator and a shared network; a synthetic-injection training method, driven by an Ornstein-Uhlenbeck drift model and anchored to real recordings, overcomes the scarcity of labelled ENF data; a reference-matching channel verifies a claimed time of recording and recovers an unknown one; and a two-axis agentic orchestrator fuses recording authenticity with content-manipulation evidence under an asymmetric rule, escalating expensive detectors only when needed. A central finding reframes the task: an ENF-band flicker is present in generated video at a prominence indistinguishable from real footage, so its presence is not proof of authenticity, and authentication must rest on consistency with an independent reference rather than on presence. On held-out real recordings the detector accepts genuine audio and video at 93% and 100% against naive baselines of 53% and 15%; claimed-time authentication reaches an area under the curve of 1.0; and the agentic cascade matches a flat ensemble while cutting wall-clock time by 54% and frames decoded by 64%, without loss of accuracy.
items.comment: 12 pages, 17 figures, 4 tables. Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Information Forensics and Security. Code and data: https://github.com/RyanSolent95/enf-video-forensics

items.title_en: VesperMUSE: Multi-Modal Fusion Vision Transformer for Image Semantic Segmentation Under Diverse Light Conditions
items.title_zh: VesperMUSE：面向多样光照条件下图像语义分割的多模态融合视觉 Transformer
items.abstract_en: Semantic segmentation is critical for the reliable navigation and scene understanding of autonomous systems, yet its performance degrades severely in low-light environments due to noise, artifacts, colour distortion, and the loss of structural details. To address this challenge, this work introduces VesperMUSE, a unified multi-modal framework designed to achieve robust image semantic segmentation across diverse illumination conditions. The architecture addresses the light deficiency problem on multiple levels: proposing a novel physics-informed synthetic low-light adaptation algorithm, approaching Low-Light Image Enhancement (LLIE) through a thermal-guided paradigm, and finally aiming to recover the intrinsic scene details for semantic segmentation through a multi-modal fusion approach. Following enhancement, the framework dynamically integrates the primary RGB features with auxiliary thermal representations and surface normal maps highlighting geometric discontinuities and material boundaries. At the core of this integration is a highly scalable, modality-agnostic self-attention mechanism that extracts both global context and fine local features from an arbitrary number of auxiliary inputs. By combining and projecting these hierarchical multi-modal representations into a unified component, the attention module allows the network to selectively attend to relevant cross-modal cues without requiring any architectural modifications when different sensor configurations are used. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that VesperMUSE successfully recovers missing visual cues, providing a flexible, state-of-the-art (SOTA) solution for machine perception in extreme and unstructured real-world environments.

items.title_en: GRID-Planner: Graph-Structured Relational Reward Shaping for Diffusion Planning
items.title_zh: GRID-Planner：面向扩散规划的图结构关系奖励塑形
items.abstract_en: Autonomous driving planning requires selecting trajectories that remain safe, rule-compliant, and comfortable under complex multi-agent interactions, yet robust closed-loop decision making in planning-critical scenes remains challenging. Existing diffusion- and RL-based planners often rely on generic rewards and use relational structure mainly for representation, limiting how planning-critical rollouts shape policy improvement. We present GRID-Planner, a graph--reward integrated diffusion planning framework that aligns generative planning with structured relational signals. Specifically, GRID-Planner combines graph-aware importance weighting, a time-indexed relational reward surrogate, and an advantage-weighted diffusion objective with on-policy self-distillation, forming a rollout-return-advantage-update loop without explicit likelihoods. Experiments on nuPlan and interPlan show that, compared with the diffusion-only baseline, GRID-Planner reduces collision rate, lane deviation, and jerk by 35.8\%, 60.8\%, and 27.4\%, respectively, and improves the planning score by 3.4\%. Project website: https://github.com/yangzhaojason/GRID-Planner.

items.title_en: Training-Free Target-Aware Refinement of 3D Gaussian Language Map
items.title_zh: 免训练的目标感知三维高斯语言地图细化
items.abstract_en: Distilling vision-language features into 3D Gaussian Splatting yields a language map that can be queried with arbitrary text. In deployment, however, a small set of user-specified targets must be reliably located, which current distilled maps often miss, while open-vocabulary queryability for other words must remain intact. We propose a training-free, target-aware refinement of an already-distilled language map. Guided by a text-promptable segmenter, the visual embedding inside each detected target region is blended with the target text embedding, a convex combination whose coefficient sets the amount of injected prior, while non-target regions are left untouched. Injecting too much overwrites appearance cues and general queryability, so we seek, for each target, the smallest coefficient that still lets it win, and we obtain every coefficient in closed form, leaving no hyperparameters to tune. We further identify a failure mode of injection in language-goal localization. Text embeddings share a common component, and injecting them makes the standard cosine read-out query-agnostic, which a centering step in the read-out removes. Across three benchmarks, the refinement consistently improves open-vocabulary segmentation, roughly doubling the base mIoU on Replica, and localizes language goals more reliably than the base map. It also transfers as a plug-in to off-the-shelf field-based and object-level language maps and supports a real-world demonstration in which a legged robot navigates to natural-language goals. Project page and code: https://lab-of-ai-and-robotics.github.io/target-aware-langmap/

items.title_en: MYOPIA: Understanding the Limits of Tree-Based Reasoning in Vision-Language Models
items.title_zh: MYOPIA：理解视觉-语言模型中树式推理的局限
items.abstract_en: Decision trees can make vision-language model (VLM) classification interpretable by replacing a single prediction with a sequence of root-to-leaf questions. However, the accuracy cost of this greedy, non-backtracking procedure remains unclear. We introduce \textbf{MYOPIA}, a benchmark comprising four LLM-generated, human-refined decision trees for GTSRB, MNIST, CIFAR-10, and MSCOCO, together with matched prompts, diagnostic protocols, and an evaluation harness. Across GPT-4o, Qwen-VL Max, and LLaMA-3.2 11B Vision, tree traversal underperforms zero-shot prompting in all 12 dataset--model pairs; paired bootstrap analyses consistently favor zero-shot. Our diagnostics characterize interacting failure modes associated with this gap. Models often recall tree-encoded class attributes more accurately than they ground the same attributes in images: the mean label--image accuracy gaps are 9.5, 13.8, and 12.6 points for GPT-4o, Qwen-VL Max, and LLaMA, respectively. Incorrect local decisions then irreversibly exclude the correct class, while answer extraction introduces additional model-dependent loss. A node-level audit of the four trees finds that split entropy is weakly but consistently associated with lower node accuracy, whereas depth, branching factor, and within-node grounding differences are less stable. \textbf{MYOPIA} therefore provides a framework for diagnosing hierarchical visual classification and motivates testing tree designs that prioritize perceptual answerability and recovery from early errors. Code is available at https://github.com/islammesabah/VLM_Classification.

items.title_en: CarryOn: A Dual-Loop Harness for Personalized and Reliable Robot Assistance
items.title_zh: CarryOn：面向个性化且可靠机器人辅助的双环框架
items.abstract_en: While generalist vision-language-action (VLA) models have enabled diverse open-world manipulation, real-world robotic assistance requires two critical capabilities they currently lack: personalization and reliable execution. First, executing an instruction like "make me a sandwich" requires grounding subtask decomposition in persistent user preferences rather than relying on a single generic solution. Second, reliable deployment demands explainable safety assurance that proactively prevents hazards and gracefully recovers from occasional physical failures. To address these gaps, we present CarryOn, a dual-loop harness designed to augment a frozen VLA policy. The planning loop maintains persistent user-level and scene-level context that is continually grounded against new observations and revised through interaction, enabling personalized task selection and execution grounding across conversations and changing scenes. The execution loop actively supervises policy rollouts, shielding actions from predicted hazardous contact. When execution fails, the system invokes reusable control-based recovery skills that restore task progress and are refined through reflection on earlier failures. On a real robot and in simulation, CarryOn dispatches preference-consistent subtasks across users and scenes, reduces the violation rate of an already safety-finetuned VLA from 52.6% to 6.1%, and increases recovery success from 13% to 80% when refined skills are reused.

items.title_en: RLDF: A Region-Level Deepfake Dataset and Benchmark for Partial-Face Manipulation Detection
items.title_zh: RLDF：面向局部人脸篡改检测的区域级深度伪造数据集与基准
items.abstract_en: Existing deepfake detection models are built upon manipu- lated images that are tampered with either exclusively fully swapped or fully synthesised faces, which leads us to an open question: Can off-the-shelf deepfake models detect manipulation effectively while tampering is confined to a local facial sub-region? To fill this gap, we introduce RLDF (Region-Level Deepfake), the first dataset for region-level deepfake evaluation. Employing the proposed region-aware partial swap synthesis model, we generate over 2M par- tial face-swap images by using eight face-swapping meth- ods. Altogether, we considered seven face regions, among which there are four discrete regions (eye, nose, mouth and eyebrow) and four composite facial regions (eye and nose; eye, nose and mouth; eye, nose, mouth and eye- brow; and full face). In addition, we define three evalu- ation protocols and benchmark 12 state-of-the-art detectors across the five popular standard cross-dataset evaluations, DF40, and the proposed RLDF, providing a comprehen- sive audit of where and why existing detectors underper- formed. Our evaluation reveals that existing detectors fail to generalize consistently across partial facial regions, re- sulting in an overall drop of 10.5% AUC and 10% accu- racy under region-level evaluation. Further, we propose a mask-guided cross-attention model as a baseline approach that can effectively detect region-level manipulation. The proposed dataset, code, and checkpoints are available at https://github.com/RLDF-Dataset/RLDF.

items.title_en: CLAD: Keypoint Matching Using Global Line Correspondences
items.title_zh: CLAD：利用全局线对应的关键点匹配
items.abstract_en: Traditional keypoint descriptors, such as SIFT (Scale-Invariant Feature Transform) and ORB (Oriented FAST and Rotated BRIEF), are computed from local image patches. They may be unreliable in scenes with repetitive patterns or weak textures, where patches at different locations can look similar. We propose the Contextual Line-Assisted Descriptor (CLAD), a keypoint matching method that addresses this problem by using global geometric context from line correspondences. CLAD represents each keypoint with a vector whose elements indicate its proximity to matched lines. It can therefore use the keypoint's spatial relationships to the lines in the scene. We use HOME (Hough-space One-dimensional Matching of Extrema) to detect both clear and weak linear structures and to establish enough line-to-keypoint associations to represent this context. Evaluations on the TUM RGB-D SLAM dataset and outdoor video sequences show that CLAD provides geometrically consistent matches that complement those obtained with traditional local descriptors. In repetitive scenes, where local descriptors may not distinguish similar patches, CLAD uses global structure to improve matching reliability. The method is computationally lightweight and practical to implement.

items.title_en: Perception or Reasoning? Diagnosing and Tackling Reinforcement Learning Bottlenecks in VLMs
items.title_zh: 感知还是推理？诊断与应对视觉-语言模型中的强化学习瓶颈
items.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning has brought strong gains to language model reasoning, but its improvements on visual tasks remain less consistent. One difficulty is that visual task failures can arise from different sources: the same benchmark may be limited by perception for one model and by reasoning for another. We introduce Perception and Reasoning Attribution (PARA), which measures the remaining perceptual and reasoning headroom of each model--benchmark pair by comparing how many current errors are recovered with more accurate visual information versus a stronger reasoner. Across 4 vision-language models and 17 multimodal benchmarks, PARA broadly agrees with the expected characteristics of existing benchmarks while revealing substantial model-specific variation. More importantly, it shows that RL gains become smaller as perceptual headroom increases, but larger when reasoning explains more of the recoverable errors, suggesting that current RL exploits reasoning headroom more effectively than perceptual headroom. Motivated by this gap, we analyze how existing RL objectives affect visual perception and find that reward- and token-level signals influence visual attention only indirectly. We therefore propose GRAD, a group-relative attention distillation objective that uses the best rollout in each group to directly guide the visual attention of weaker rollouts. GRAD consistently improves performance across two model scales and seven benchmarks, and further complements existing RL methods.

items.title_en: SpaceCache: Intermediate Feature Reuse for Efficient Semantic Segmentation on Point Cloud Streams
items.title_zh: SpaceCache：面向点云流高效语义分割的中间特征复用
items.abstract_en: Point-cloud streams are central to autonomous driving and robotics, yet existing segmentation networks process every frame from scratch, although consecutive frames largely overlap. We observe that the intermediate features of point-cloud transformers remain semantically consistent across frames for the same spatial region, especially in deep stages. Building on this, we present SpaceCache, a training-free feature cache that reuses these features across frames. Tokens of previously observed regions skip a sequence of transformer blocks and take their cached features, only the remaining tokens are computed, and the full token layout is restored for dense prediction. Lightweight cache management keeps reused features reliable by limiting each entry's age and evicting low-confidence entries. Unlike token merging, SpaceCache selects tokens at negligible cost and runs its cache operations once per encoder stage. On both outdoor and indoor benchmarks, such as nuScenes, Waymo, and ScanNet, with two transformer backbones of Utonia and LitePT-B, SpaceCache achieves up to 1.65x speedup with less than 1-point mIoU drop and consistently outperforms token-merging methods.

items.title_en: Trajectory Prediction Method for person under WSN with Hierarchical Envelope Adversarial Domain Adaptation
items.title_zh: 基于分层包络对抗域适应的无线传感器网络人员轨迹预测方法
items.abstract_en: Pedestrian trajectory prediction holds significant applications across autonomous driving, intelligent surveillance, and smart cities. However, the complexity and unpredictability of pedestrian interactions make this task a persistent challenge. Current models face two common limitations: 1) Consider only a single type of social coupling. This introduces redundant interactions. More critically, it fails to account for the varying nature of trajectory coupled across different scenarios and between different pedestrians. Consequently, models cannot deeply adapt to diverse scenes. 2) Inadequate domain shift handling. Although very few methods address domain shift, they rely on statistical criterion-based domain distribution alignment. Such approaches exhibit strong dependency on predefined statistical metrics. This leads to significant limitations in complex and dynamic environments. To address these problems, a Hierarchical Envelope Adversarial Domain Adaptation with Loosely-Tightly coupled model (HEADA-LTCTPM) is proposed. First, an envelope sample construction mechanism was proposed. It constructs envelope samples and extends them into graph structures. Secondly, an adversarial domain adaptation module was proposed. This integrates both local and global domain adaptation strategies. It dynamically adapts to diverse coupled relationships across scenarios. These innovations collectively enhance prediction accuracy and robustness. In the experimental section, two representative public datasets were employed for validation and comprehensive comparisons with six relevant baseline algorithms were conducted. Results demonstrate that our model achieves significantly higher accuracy compared to existing methods, with the ADE and FDE metrics reduced by 17.6% and 19.1% respectively. The time overhead meets practical requirements, which verifies the effectiveness of our key innovations.

items.title_en: RoPE-Flow: Monocular Vision-based Robot Pose Estimation via 2D Graph-Conditioned 3D Flow Matching
items.title_zh: RoPE-Flow：基于单目视觉的机器人位姿估计——通过二维图条件三维流匹配
items.abstract_en: Camera-to-robot pose estimation from a monocular image is significant for vision-based robot navigation and control. However, recovering 3D structural features from 2D observations remains a challenging task. Existing camera-to-robot pose estimation methods either rely on time-consuming iterative rendering or involve sophisticated 2D-3D registration which suffers from projection ambiguity, accumulated errors for distal joints and imbalanced learning for different joints. In this work, we propose RoPE-Flow, an end-to-end flow matching-based framework for camera-to-robot pose estimation. From the predicted 2D heatmaps, we propose a Keypoint-centered Feature Extractor to obtain positional features along with contextual representations from keypoints-centered multi-scale patches. Moreover, we introduce Graph-guided Condition Generator, which embeds a learnable adjacency map to generate condition for flow matching based on correlation among keypoints. Besides, we introduce Bone Length Loss and Ray-Depth Loss for topological consistency and scale stability, with joint-wise weighting to mitigate varied prediction difficulty across joints. The proposed method outperforms state-of-the-art methods for pose estimation across different types of robots with mutiple cameras. Besides, we establish a novel cross-scene benchmark to demonstrate the outstanding performance of RoPE-Flow on zero-shot cross-scene robot pose estimation. Meanwhile, animated visualizations are shown on the website: ropeflow.netlify.app

items.title_en: Audio-Visual Dog Identification and Tracking in Real-World Videos
items.title_zh: 真实世界视频中的视听狗识别与跟踪
items.abstract_en: Identifying individual dogs from barks in real-world videos remains challenging and largely unexplored. Solving this problem would enable long-term behavioral analysis, veterinary monitoring, and animal welfare monitoring by attributing vocalizations and behaviors to the correct individual. Real-world videos are challenging because multiple dogs may bark simultaneously, become occluded, or move in and out of view. Prior studies show that canine vocalizations and visual appearance contain discriminative identity information, but these modalities have largely been studied independently. We present a multimodal dog-fingerprinting framework combining visual identification, multiple-object tracking, and canine vocal fingerprinting to associate bark events with individual dogs while maintaining persistent profiles. The framework synchronizes bark events with tracked dogs and updates profiles using visual appearance and vocal characteristics, enabling identification despite occlusion, overlapping vocalizations, and off-screen barking. We also introduce a benchmark of 46 real-world videos containing 213 manually annotated bark events. Our framework correctly localizes the active visible dog in 61.83% of visible events at IoU $\geq 0.30$ and achieves a 91.33% F1 score for visible versus off-screen barking detection.

items.title_en: Line-Augmented cuVSLAM: Robust Visual Odometry in Low-Texture Environments
items.title_zh: Line-Augmented cuVSLAM：低纹理环境下的鲁棒视觉里程计
items.abstract_en: Autonomous mobile robots in warehouses and production facilities operate in precisely the environments that defeat point-feature visual odometry: featureless aisles, uniform walls, repetitive racking and specular floors. Such environments are, however, rich in straight-edge structure: rack uprights, door frames, wall junctions and cabinet outlines present high-contrast linear edges stable across wide viewpoint changes. A line-feature extension to cuVSLAM, a CUDA-accelerated visual-SLAM system, is presented that recovers this signal. Lines are parameterised as Plücker coordinates for geometric transport and as the minimal 4-DOF orthonormal representation of Bartoli and Sturm for optimisation; a Cauchy-robust point-to-line residual with analytic Jacobians is folded directly into cuVSLAM's per-frame Gauss-Newton pose solve, and the same line state is jointly refined in the Schur-complement sliding-window bundle adjustment. An adaptive information weight causes lines to assume more of the estimation burden exactly as point features become scarce, and the extension adds residual blocks to existing solvers rather than introducing a second estimator, reducing exactly to the unmodified point pipeline when disabled. Evaluated in RGB-D mode under SE(3) Umeyama alignment with no scale correction, line features reduce mean absolute trajectory error by 38.5% over the 22 sequences of the TUM RGB-D Freiburg3 collection and by 30.1% over the 8 Replica room and office sequences, where median translation error falls by 38.9% and median rotation error by 66.4%, with zero tracking failures in any configuration tested.

items.title_en: EgoJEPA: Beyond Retargeting for Dexterous Manipulation from Egocentric Videos
items.title_zh: EgoJEPA：超越重定向的自我中心视频灵巧操作学习
items.abstract_en: Egocentric human videos offer a scalable alternative to costly robot demonstra- tions, yet transferring their manipulation priors to robot control remains chal- lenging. The commonly adopted retargeting-based approaches convert human wrist and finger poses into embodiment-specific action commands through hand- crafted geometric mappings. However, such mappings require meticulous recal- ibration across different embodiments and risk propagating hand-tracking errors into downstream robot control pipelines. To this end, we propose EgoJEPA, a three-stage framework that learns embodiment-agnostic representations from ego- centric human videos without rule-based human-to-robot retargeting: 1) Human- action pre-training learns effect-aware latent actions through JEPA-style visual prediction conditioned on hand-motion differences; 2) Latent-action-based world modeling jointly predicts future visual dynamics and latent actions, which decou- ples human prior pre-training from robot-specific control parameterizations; 3) Embodiment-specific tuning adapts the pretrained model to diverse robots through lightweight action adapters. Experiments on five real-world manipulation tasks across three robot embodiments demonstrate the effectiveness and efficiency of EgoJEPA. It achieves a 74% average success rate under the out-of-domain evalu- ation, compared with 65% for the retargeting baseline, while reducing cumulative cross-embodiment wall-clock cost by 47.2%, from 743.2 to 392.7 hours.

items.title_en: ReasonUni: Reasoning-Augmented Reconstruction Advances Unified Multimodal Models
items.title_zh: ReasonUni：推理增强重建推进统一多模态模型
items.abstract_en: Image-to-text (I2T) understanding and text-to-image (T2I) generation are dual tasks in unified multimodal models (UMMs). Reconstructive post-training couples these tasks, but existing reconstruction-based methods remain perception-centric and provide limited supervision for reasoning about structure, intent, and transformation. We propose ReasonUni, a reasoning-augmented reconstructive post-training framework that extends this coupling beyond perception. Given an original image and an editing instruction, the UMM first reasons about what and how to edit and describes the target state, then generates the corresponding target image conditioned on this understanding output. To jointly optimize both modules, we introduce TreeGRPO, a tree-structured reinforcement learning method that samples multiple reasoning paths and candidate images per path, then aggregates visual rewards to update both modules under a unified objective. Experiments across multiple benchmarks demonstrate consistent gains in both understanding and generation, showing that reasoning-augmented reconstruction yields genuine mutual gains for UMMs.

items.title_en: Player-1: Learning to Play from Synthetic Experience
items.title_zh: Player-1：从合成经验中学习博弈
items.abstract_en: Computer-use agents have demonstrated strong capabilities in interpreting screens and executing keyboard and mouse actions. However, games, with their visually rich worlds and diverse mechanics, remain challenging and offer a demanding next step toward general digital control. Current game-agent learning pipelines often rely on large-scale demonstrations with limited coverage of dynamic game states, while scalable environments for interactive training remain difficult to obtain. We introduce Player-1, a post-training framework for learning game control beyond demonstrations through synthetic experience. We extend the computer-use action space with relative pointer motion, sustained inputs, and composite actions. For supervised initialization, we fine-tune computer-use models on 6,044 curated gameplay trajectories that pair recorded actions with task instructions and visual reasoning. We construct Player-1-Gym, sixteen synthetic 2D and 3D environments designed around control demands shared across games. Programmatically verifiable rewards and randomized observations and control dynamics support multi-environment reinforcement learning with PPO. The resulting Player-1-9B and Player-1-35B-A3B improve MineDojo-300 success over their SFT policies by 27.8 and 17.7 percentage points, respectively. Player-1-9B reaches 38.33% success compared with 12.63% for the strongest evaluated baseline, with further gains over SFT on ViZDoom-10 and GameWorld. Further analyses show that broader synthetic environment coverage improves transfer, while the use of composite actions that combine multiple keyboard and mouse inputs increases during RL. We demonstrate that learning from synthetic experience substantially improves game control beyond supervised initialization, with gains that generalize beyond the RL training suite.

items.title_en: A Valid Watermark Is Not a Valid Identity: Spatial-Spectral Adversarial Face Evasion with Watermark Preservation
items.title_zh: 有效水印并非有效身份：兼顾水印保持的空间-光谱对抗人脸规避
items.abstract_en: Facial image watermarking can support traceability and certification in biometric pipelines, but provenance or manipulation detection alone does not guarantee reliable biometric identity. We introduce a watermark-preserving face evasion attack that targets this gap under a black-box watermarking setting, without access to the watermarking components. The proposed PGD-L_2 attack guides adversarial perturbations with spatial and spectral preservation terms to reduce face-recognition similarity while limiting pixel-level distortion and high-frequency changes that may interfere with hidden watermark cues. Evaluated on controlled facial images with two watermarking schemes, two face-recognition models, and two datasets, the attack achieves evasion rates above 92% at operational thresholds while preserving watermark recovery above 93% for StegaFormer and above 99.7% for FaceSigns, with visual quality above 47dB PSNR at epsilon_2=2.0. These results expose a structural gap in watermark-based facial certification: a face image can remain watermark-valid and visually faithful while becoming biometrically unreliable.

items.title_en: When Pairwise Preferences Cycle: A Reliability-Anchored Preference Walk for Video GRPO
items.title_zh: 当成对偏好发生循环：面向视频 GRPO 的可靠性锚定偏好游走
items.abstract_en: Pairwise preference feedback has become a widely adopted supervision signal for reinforcement learning in video generation models, as pairwise comparisons provide a more reliable alternative than pointwise scalar ratings for evaluating the quality of generated videos. Specifically, we define a preference graph for each GRPO group under a pairwise evaluator, where nodes represent sampled rollouts and edges encode pairwise preferences. Auditing 6,976 on-policy comparison graphs, we find that cyclic preferences are prevalent and persist throughout training. Naive pairwise reward aggregation based on average win rates discards the underlying comparison structures and treats each rollout independently, which may introduce unreliable advantage estimates for certain rollouts and consequently affect reinforcement learning optimization. Therefore, we propose the \emph{Reliability-Anchored Preference Walk} (\ours{}), a graph-aware advantage aggregation method that strengthens the global preference signal from win rates with reliable relational evidence from cyclic preference graphs through a reliability-guided preference walk. Under matched evaluator, comparison protocol, group size, prompt schedule, and query budget, \ours{} requires no additional evaluator queries beyond the observed comparisons within each rollout group and improves over Pairwise-GRPO across controlled comparisons, transfer settings, and blind human evaluations.

items.title_en: GeoCloak: An Agentic Framework for Semantics-Preserving Geolocation Privacy via Peripheral Clue Manipulation
items.title_zh: GeoCloak：通过外围线索操纵实现语义保持地理定位隐私的智能体框架
items.abstract_en: The rapid advancement of large vision language models (LVLMs) has made geolocation inference from images highly accurate and accessible. This poses serious privacy risks: a passive adversary with black-box LVLM access can infer a user's location from a single photo with no metadata. Existing protection methods rely almost exclusively on adversarial perturbation, which introduces perceptible visual artifacts and utility degradation. We identify the visual-geolocation asymmetry: geolocation-decisive clues, such as street signs, tend to be visually peripheral but dominate location inference. Exploiting this asymmetry, we propose GeoCloak, an agentic framework for semantics-preserving geolocation privacy protection. It acts as a clue-aware planner that analyzes each image to identify geolocation-relevant clues, dispatches targeted semantic edits to directly suppress peripheral clues, and autonomously configures adversarial perturbation to further suppress residual geolocation features, all under iterative utility-aware feedback. We evaluate GeoCloak on four diverse datasets spanning 108 countries and 576 cities against five LVLMs and three inference methods. GeoCloak reduces overall city-level accuracy from 41.2% to 9.9%, approximately half of the best-performing baseline, while achieving substantially superior utility preservation both qualitatively and quantitatively. We hope this work takes a meaningful step toward practical, semantics-preserving geolocation privacy protection, giving users greater control over the location information inadvertently embedded in their shared images.

items.title_en: Complementary Future Token Pruning for World Action Models
items.title_zh: 面向世界动作模型的互补未来 Token 剪枝
items.abstract_en: World action models (WAMs) jointly predict future visual states and robot actions, but processing dense future-frame tokens incurs substantial inference latency. We propose CF-Prune, a training-free framework for pruning future-frame tokens in pretrained WAMs. Our key insight is that future visual predictions support action generation and therefore need not preserve every visual detail required for high-fidelity video synthesis. CF-Prune combines instruction and action attention to identify task-relevant tokens during the initial denoising forward pass, even when future-frame and action representations remain highly noisy. An entropy-based phase identification mechanism further retains dense computation during precision phases to mitigate pruning-induced performance degradation. Experiments on RoboLab, RoboCasa, and real-world manipulation tasks demonstrate consistent inference speedups. At a 35% pruning ratio, CF-Prune achieves average speedups of 1.19-1.27x while improving task success rates. At a 50% pruning ratio, it achieves 1.29-1.33x average speedups on both simulation benchmarks, with overall success rates within 1.0 percentage point of the baseline.

items.title_en: SAM3RL: Memory Control via Reinforcement Learning for Visual Object Tracking
items.title_zh: SAM3RL：面向视觉目标跟踪的强化学习记忆控制
items.abstract_en: Segment Anything Model 3 (SAM 3) is a foundation model for image and video segmentation that sets the state of the art in visual object tracking. Its tracker, inherited from SAM 2, stores information from past frames in a memory bank, managed by a simple First-In-First-Out rule, allowing temporal consistency in complex videos. Several recent methods improve SAM 2 with hand-crafted memory update rules, each targeting a specific failure mode, such as distractors, occlusions, or object motion. However, their gains transfer only partially to the stronger SAM 3 backbone. We instead present a more general, data-driven approach that frames memory control as a sequential decision-making task. SAM3RL is an extension of the SAM 3 tracker with a lightweight memory controller, trained by reinforcement learning, that decides which frames enter the memory bank in order to maximize tracking performance. SAM3RL sets a new state of the art on 10 of 12 tracking and video object segmentation benchmarks, outperforming all hand-crafted rules without any runtime overhead. The same approach applied to SAM 2 gives SAM2RL, which outperforms hand-crafted rules on 9 of the 12 benchmarks, showing the generality of our method across model generations.

items.title_en: BluePixel: Toward Native 4K Agentic Image Editing
items.title_zh: BluePixel：迈向原生 4K 智能体图像编辑
items.abstract_en: Instruction-driven image editing has reached native 4K, yet how such editors are trained remains undisclosed, and pretraining one from scratch is beyond most teams. The task itself compounds the difficulty: a single end-to-end editor cannot make precise parametric adjustments, match specialized experts, or interpret the vague instructions users actually write. We argue that 4K editing is a system problem rather than a single-model problem, and present BluePixel, which couples a native-4K editing model with an agent harness; the complete training recipe is disclosed in this paper. The model makes 4K training practical: it turns a 1K-pretrained editor into a native-4K one through progressive VAE adaptation that keeps 4K training as affordable as 1K, absorbs a long tail of vertical editing skills through continual learning, and refines the aesthetic-fidelity trade-off with reinforcement learning. Distillation via source-anchored target projection (SATP) then compresses 50 denoising steps to 4, completing a 4K edit in 8.7 s on a single Kunlunxin P800 XPU while preserving task success rate and background consistency. The harness, BluePixel Agent, makes editing controllable: it decomposes user instructions into specialist and general operations, verifies every result with the same reward model that guided training, and retries within bounded attempts. On VINS-4KEval++ (3,305 native-4K cases), BluePixel ranks second among seven models, behind only GPT Image 2 in non-edited-region consistency.

items.title_en: FPV-CRASH: A Dataset for Offline Crash Moment Localization in Drone First-Person-View Videos
items.title_zh: FPV-CRASH：用于无人机第一人称视角视频中离线碰撞时刻定位的数据集
items.abstract_en: Crash Moment Localization aims to localize the major physical impact that interrupts controlled flight in an onboard first-person-view (FPV) video recorded by a drone, thereby providing a temporal reference for retrospective crash analysis in aerial robotics. However, existing crash-video datasets predominantly target surveillance or dash-camera footage, and their annotation schemes and task formulations are not designed for temporal localization of the major physical impact in UAV onboard FPV videos. To address this gap, we present FPV-CRASH, a dataset and fixed-protocol reference evaluation for offline Crash Moment Localization in drone FPV videos. FPV-CRASH contains 1,052 drone FPV clips (526 Crash and 526 Normal); each Crash clip has a single-frame reference annotation for the Crash Moment, and every clip is paired with four English captions automatically generated from sampled frames and the known Crash/Normal label. Normal clips carry no timestamp target and provide training-time background supervision. The captions support an auxiliary Text-to-Video Retrieval task, whereas localization inference remains video-only. We further provide a heatmap-based reference model that estimates a continuous Crash Moment timestamp from sparsely sampled frames. Under the fixed, non-source-disjoint clip-level protocol, the reference model reduces MAE from 1.12 s for the strongest fixed timing-prior baseline to 0.56 s (a 50% relative reduction) and achieves a median absolute error (MedAE) of 0.33 s; the fraction of clips localized within 0.5 s rises from 37.14% to 65.71%. The release includes annotations, available source video identifiers and URLs, clipping metadata, fixed split lists, and preprocessing code so that the reportable portion can be reconstructed without redistributing source footage. At submission time, all source-compilation URLs remained accessible.

items.title_en: HyperLoop: Hyperspectral-Assisted Loop Closure Detection in 3D-SLAM for Planetary Exploration
items.title_zh: HyperLoop：面向行星探索的3D-SLAM中高光谱辅助回环检测
items.abstract_en: Autonomous navigation of planetary rovers is challenged by visually repetitive, featureless terrain. SLAM systems based on 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) offer dense mapping but rely on RGB appearance descriptors that degrade under perceptual aliasing - a common failure mode in extraterrestrial environments where physically distinct locations appear visually identical. This paper presents HyperLoop, the first framework integrating hyperspectral imaging (HSI) into the loop closure module of a 3DGS-based SLAM system. Hyperspectral descriptors encode material-level spectral signatures complementing RGB features, providing robustness to illumination changes and visual repetitiveness. Two HSI descriptor families are introduced: Bag-of-Spectral-Words (BoSW), encoding spectral material distributions via TF-IDF weighted histograms, and PCA-K VLAD (PCAK-VLAD), capturing first-order residual statistics of PCA-compressed spectral signatures. Both are evaluated with SIFT-VLAD and NetVLAD RGB descriptors under Strict-AND and Weighted fusion strategies on a custom dataset from the Moon-Mars Outdoor Test Site (MMOTS) at DLR, comprising synchronized RGB-D and hyperspectral sequences across four planetary analog traverses (65.5 m total). A key finding is that the sensor's Red-NIR range (600-860 nm) provides limited discriminability for rock terrain: the best HSI fusion (SIFT-VLAD + BoSW, Strict-AND) achieves 5.04 cm ATE RMSE, within 1.8% of SIFT-VLAD alone (4.95 cm). The gain over NetVLAD (8.81 cm) is attributable to SIFT-VLAD, not HSI fusion. This motivates future adoption of SWIR sensors capturing diagnostic mineral absorption features absent from the 600-860 nm range for planetary SLAM missions.
